messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites GNU C++ code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

<perturbed_code_1>
#include <iostream>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int main(){
    string in, out;
    cin >> in;
    int lng = in.length();
    out = "";
    out += in[0];
    bool at = false;
    int i = 1;
    while (i < lng){
        if (!at && i < lng - 2 && in[i] == 'a' && in[i+1] == 't'){
            out += "@";
            at = true;
            i++;
        }else if (i < lng - 3 && in.substr(i, 3) == "dot"){
            out += ".";
            i+=2;
        }else{
            out += in[i];
        }
        i++;
    }
    cout << out << endl;
    return 0;
}
